metadata.measurement_scope: repository checks only, including AST parsing and artifact loading; built-ins excluded equally from all modes
metadata.source_tree_note: Code at revision above; pending qualification documentation is included where fingerprinted. No analysis inputs changed during measurements.

header_filters.wider/extended: clang_tidy_runner.first_party_header_filter(workspace_root), as fingerprinted at the recorded revision

metadata.schedule: One warmup per mode, then five measured samples per mode; forward/reverse/forward/reverse/forward order.
metadata.counterfactual_build:
load("@rules_cc//cc:defs.bzl", "cc_binary")
cc_binary(
    name = "fastecu_tidy",
    srcs = ["FastecuTidyModule.cpp"] + glob(["*.h"]) + ["AccumulateLoopCheck.cpp", "AnyAllIndexLoopCheck.cpp", "ContainerAssertionCheck.cpp", "CountIfLoopCheck.cpp", "LinearSearchLoopCheck.cpp", "MessageConcatenationCheck.cpp", "RedundantAddressDereferenceCheck.cpp", "ResultAssertionCheck.cpp", "TransformCollectLoopCheck.cpp"],
    copts = ["-std=c++20", "-fno-rtti", "-fno-exceptions"],
    linkopts = select({"@platforms//os:macos": ["-undefined", "dynamic_lookup"], "//conditions:default": []}),
    linkshared = True,
    tags = ["manual"],
    deps = ["@local_llvm//:clang_tidy_headers"],
)

mode_configuration.legacy:
CheckOptions:
  fastecu.ExceptionsFile: ${WORKSPACE}/.clang-tidy-exceptions.yaml
Checks: -*,custom-fastecu-redundant-address-dereference,custom-fastecu-result-assertion,custom-fastecu-container-assertion,custom-fastecu-message-concatenation,custom-fastecu-linear-search-loop,custom-fastecu-any-all-index-loop,custom-fastecu-count-if-loop,custom-fastecu-accumulate-loop,custom-fastecu-transform-collect-loop
CustomChecks:
- Diagnostic:
  - BindName: address
    Level: Warning
    Message: remove redundant &*; use std::to_address for object pointers and contiguous
      iterators
  Name: fastecu-redundant-address-dereference
  Query: "match unaryOperator(
  hasOperatorName("&"),
  unless(isTypeDependent()),
\
    \  hasUnaryOperand(
    ignoringParenImpCasts(
      anyOf(
        unaryOperator(hasOperatorName("\
    *")),
        cxxOperatorCallExpr(
          hasOverloadedOperatorName("*"\
    ),
          callee(cxxMethodDecl()),
          hasArgument(0, ignoringParenImpCasts(expr(
\
    \            hasType(hasUnqualifiedDesugaredType(recordType(hasDeclaration(classTemplateSpecializationDecl(
\
    \              anyOf(
                allOf(
                  isInStdNamespace(),
\
    \                  anyOf(
                    allOf(
                      matchesName("\
    (^|::)__wrap_iter$"),
                      hasTemplateArgument(0, refersToType(pointerType()))
\
    \                    ),
                    matchesName("(^|::)(__bounded_iter|__static_bounded_iter|_Vector_(const_)?iterator|_String_(const_)?iterator|_Array_(const_)?iterator|_Span_iterator)$"\
    )
                  )
                ),
                allOf(
         \
    \         matchesName("^::__gnu_cxx::(__[0-9]+::)?__normal_iterator$"),
  \
    \                hasTemplateArgument(0, refersToType(pointerType()))
       \
    \         )
              )
            )))))
          )))
        )
  \
    \    )
    )
  )
).bind("address")
"
- Diagnostic:
  - BindName: assertion
    Level: Warning
    Message: assert Result/Status with IsOk(), IsErr(), or IsErrWith() rather than
      a bare boolean assertion
  Name: fastecu-result-assertion
  Query: "match cxxConstructExpr(
  hasType(
    recordType(hasDeclaration(cxxRecordDecl(hasName("\
    ::testing::AssertionResult"))))
  ),
  anyOf(
    isExpandedFromMacro("EXPECT_TRUE"\
    ),
    isExpandedFromMacro("EXPECT_FALSE"),
    isExpandedFromMacro("ASSERT_TRUE"\
    ),
    isExpandedFromMacro("ASSERT_FALSE")
  ),
  hasArgument(
    0,
\
    \    ignoringImplicit(
      ignoringParenImpCasts(
        anyOf(
       \
    \   cxxMemberCallExpr(
            callee(
              cxxMethodDecl(
  \
    \              hasName("has_value"),
                ofClass(
           \
    \       classTemplateSpecializationDecl(
                    hasName("::std::expected"\
    ),
                    hasTemplateArgument(
                      1,
     \
    \                 refersToType(recordType(hasDeclaration(cxxRecordDecl(hasName("\
    ::fastecu::Error")))))
                    )
                  )
        \
    \        )
              )
            )
          ).bind("assertion"),
\
    \          unaryOperator(
            hasOperatorName("!"),
            hasUnaryOperand(
\
    \              ignoringImplicit(
                ignoringParenImpCasts(
   \
    \               cxxMemberCallExpr(
                    callee(
            \
    \          cxxMethodDecl(
                        hasName("has_value"),
 \
    \                       ofClass(
                          classTemplateSpecializationDecl(
\
    \                            hasName("::std::expected"),
                 \
    \           hasTemplateArgument(
                              1,
         \
    \                     refersToType(recordType(hasDeclaration(cxxRecordDecl(hasName("\
    ::fastecu::Error")))))
                            )
                     \
    \     )
                        )
                      )
                \
    \    )
                  ).bind("assertion")
                )
         \
    \     )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  unless(isExpansionInFileMatching("\
    (^|.*[/\\\\])src[/\\\\]backend[/\\\\]ports[/\\\\]result_test[.]cpp$"\
    ))
)
"
- Diagnostic:
  - BindName: assertion
    Level: Warning
    Message: assert container properties with Google Mock matchers instead of reducing
      the predicate to a boolean
  Name: fastecu-container-assertion
  Query: "match cxxConstructExpr(
  hasType(
    recordType(hasDeclaration(cxxRecordDecl(hasName("\
    ::testing::AssertionResult"))))
  ),
  anyOf(
    isExpandedFromMacro("EXPECT_TRUE"\
    ),
    isExpandedFromMacro("EXPECT_FALSE"),
    isExpandedFromMacro("ASSERT_TRUE"\
    ),
    isExpandedFromMacro("ASSERT_FALSE")
  ),
  hasArgument(
    0,
\
    \    ignoringImplicit(
      ignoringParenImpCasts(
        anyOf(
       \
    \   expr(
            anyOf(
              callExpr(
                callee(functionDecl(hasAnyName("\
    ::std::all_of", "::std::any_of", "::std::none_of")))
              ),
\
    \              cxxOperatorCallExpr(
                hasOverloadedOperatorName("\
    ()"),
                hasArgument(
                  0,
                 \
    \ ignoringParenImpCasts(
                    declRefExpr(
                 \
    \     to(
                        varDecl(
                          hasAnyName("\
    ::std::ranges::all_of", "::std::ranges::any_of", "::std::ranges::none_of"\
    )
                        )
                      )
                    )
\
    \                  )
                )
              )
            )
    \
    \      ).bind("assertion"),
          unaryOperator(
            hasOperatorName("\
    !"),
            hasUnaryOperand(
              ignoringImplicit(
       \
    \         ignoringParenImpCasts(
                  expr(
                  \
    \  anyOf(
                      callExpr(
                        callee(functionDecl(hasAnyName("\
    ::std::all_of", "::std::any_of", "::std::none_of")))
                  \
    \    ),
                      cxxOperatorCallExpr(
                        hasOverloadedOperatorName("\
    ()"),
                        hasArgument(
                          0,
 \
    \                         ignoringParenImpCasts(
                           \
    \ declRefExpr(
                              to(
                          \
    \      varDecl(
                                  hasAnyName("::std::ranges::all_of"\
    , "::std::ranges::any_of", "::std::ranges::none_of")
                   \
    \             )
                              )
                           \
    \ )
                          )
                        )
                \
    \      )
                    )
                  ).bind("assertion")
   \
    \             )
              )
            )
          )
        )
    \
    \  )
    )
  )
)
"
- Diagnostic:
  - BindName: message
    Level: Warning
    Message: construct this diagnostic message with std::format instead of string
      concatenation
  Name: fastecu-message-concatenation
  Query: "match callExpr(
  callee(functionDecl(hasAnyName(
    "::fastecu::Fail"\
    ,
    "::fastecu::IEventSink::Log"
  ))),
  hasArgument(1, ignoringParenImpCasts(anyOf(
\
    \    ignoringImplicit(cxxOperatorCallExpr(hasOverloadedOperatorName("+"),
\
    \      hasType(hasUnqualifiedDesugaredType(recordType(hasDeclaration(
      \
    \  cxxRecordDecl(hasName("::std::basic_string"))
      )))))),
    cxxMemberCallExpr(callee(cxxConversionDecl()),
\
    \      on(ignoringImplicit(cxxOperatorCallExpr(hasOverloadedOperatorName("+"\
    ),
        hasType(hasUnqualifiedDesugaredType(recordType(hasDeclaration(
 \
    \         cxxRecordDecl(hasName("::std::basic_string"))
        ))))
    \
    \  )))
    )
  )))
).bind("message")
"
- Diagnostic:
  - BindName: loop
    Level: Warning
    Message: Linear search loop returning a matching element or index; consider std::ranges::find
      or std::ranges::find_if
  Name: fastecu-linear-search-loop
  Query: "match stmt(
  anyOf(
    cxxForRangeStmt(
      hasLoopVariable(varDecl().bind("\
    element")),
      hasBody(
        compoundStmt(
          has(
        \
    \    ifStmt(
              hasCondition(
                expr(
           \
    \       anyOf(
                    expr(
                      anyOf(
    \
    \                    binaryOperator(hasOperatorName("==")),
              \
    \          cxxOperatorCallExpr(hasOverloadedOperatorName("=="))
          \
    \            ),
                      hasDescendant(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    element")))))
                    ),
                    binaryOperator(
\
    \                      hasOperatorName("&&"),
                      hasDescendant(
\
    \                        expr(
                          anyOf(
           \
    \                 binaryOperator(hasOperatorName("==")),
                 \
    \           cxxOperatorCallExpr(hasOverloadedOperatorName("=="))
         \
    \                 ),
                          hasDescendant(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    element")))))
                        )
                      )
         \
    \           )
                  )
                )
              ),
    \
    \          hasThen(
                compoundStmt(
                  has(
 \
    \                   returnStmt(
                      hasReturnValue(
     \
    \                   expr(
                          anyOf(
                \
    \            unaryOperator(
                              hasOperatorName("\
    &"),
                              hasUnaryOperand(
                      \
    \          ignoringParenImpCasts(
                                  declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    element"))))
                                )
                           \
    \   )
                            ),
                            expr(
   \
    \                           anyOf(
                                cxxConstructExpr(
\
    \                                  hasDeclaration(cxxConstructorDecl(ofClass(cxxRecordDecl(hasName("\
    ::std::expected"))))),
                                  hasDescendant(
  \
    \                                  unaryOperator(
                          \
    \            hasOperatorName("&"),
                                      hasUnaryOperand(
\
    \                                        ignoringParenImpCasts(
            \
    \                              declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("element"\
    ))))
                                        )
                            \
    \          )
                                    )
                        \
    \          )
                                ),
                           \
    \     hasDescendant(
                                  cxxConstructExpr(
  \
    \                                  hasDeclaration(cxxConstructorDecl(ofClass(cxxRecordDecl(hasName("\
    ::std::expected"))))),
                                    hasDescendant(
\
    \                                      unaryOperator(
                      \
    \                  hasOperatorName("&"),
                                 \
    \       hasUnaryOperand(
                                          ignoringParenImpCasts(
\
    \                                            declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    element"))))
                                          )
                 \
    \                       )
                                      )
         \
    \                           )
                                  )
         \
    \                       )
                              ),
                \
    \              unless(hasDescendant(lambdaExpr()))
                         \
    \   )
                          )
                        )
              \
    \        )
                    )
                  )
                )
  \
    \            )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    ),
    forStmt(
\
    \      hasLoopInit(declStmt(hasSingleDecl(varDecl().bind("index")))),
    \
    \  hasIncrement(
        unaryOperator(
          hasOperatorName("++"),
\
    \          hasUnaryOperand(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("index")))))
\
    \        )
      ),
      hasBody(
        compoundStmt(
          has(
\
    \            ifStmt(
              hasCondition(
                expr(
   \
    \               anyOf(
                    binaryOperator(hasOperatorName("\
    ==")),
                    cxxOperatorCallExpr(hasOverloadedOperatorName("\
    =="))
                  ),
                  hasDescendant(
             \
    \       expr(
                      anyOf(
                        arraySubscriptExpr(
\
    \                          hasIndex(
                            ignoringParenImpCasts(
\
    \                              declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("index"\
    ))))
                            )
                          )
           \
    \             ),
                        cxxOperatorCallExpr(
             \
    \             hasOverloadedOperatorName("[]"),
                          hasArgument(
\
    \                            1,
                            ignoringParenImpCasts(
\
    \                              declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("index"\
    ))))
                            )
                          )
           \
    \             )
                      )
                    )
            \
    \      )
                )
              ),
              hasThen(
      \
    \          compoundStmt(
                  has(
                    returnStmt(
\
    \                      hasReturnValue(
                        ignoringParenImpCasts(
\
    \                          expr(
                            anyOf(
       \
    \                       declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("index")))),
\
    \                              unaryOperator(
                              \
    \  hasOperatorName("&"),
                                hasUnaryOperand(
\
    \                                  ignoringParenImpCasts(
                  \
    \                  expr(
                                      anyOf(
     \
    \                                   arraySubscriptExpr(
                    \
    \                      hasIndex(
                                           \
    \ ignoringParenImpCasts(
                                              declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    index"))))
                                            )
                 \
    \                         )
                                        ),
    \
    \                                    cxxOperatorCallExpr(
                  \
    \                        hasOverloadedOperatorName("[]"),
                \
    \                          hasArgument(
                                    \
    \        1,
                                            ignoringParenImpCasts(
\
    \                                              declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    index"))))
                                            )
                 \
    \                         )
                                        )
     \
    \                                 )
                                    )
 \
    \                                 )
                                )
     \
    \                         )
                            )
                 \
    \         )
                        )

            \
    \        )
                  )
                )

        \
    \    )
          )

"
- Diagnostic:
  - BindName: loop
    Level: Warning
    Message: Index loop returning a bool from a subscripted search; consider std::ranges::any_of,
      std::ranges::all_of, or std::ranges::none_of
  Name: fastecu-any-all-index-loop
  Query: "match stmt(
  forStmt(
    hasLoopInit(declStmt(hasSingleDecl(varDecl().bind("\
    index")))),
    hasIncrement(
      unaryOperator(
        hasOperatorName("\
    ++"),
        hasUnaryOperand(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("index"\
    )))))
      )
    ),
    hasBody(
      compoundStmt(
        statementCountIs(1),
\
    \        has(
          ifStmt(
            unless(hasElse(stmt())),
     \
    \       hasCondition(
              hasDescendant(
                expr(
 \
    \                 anyOf(
                    arraySubscriptExpr(
          \
    \            hasIndex(ignoringParenImpCasts(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    index"))))))
                    ),
                    cxxOperatorCallExpr(
\
    \                      hasOverloadedOperatorName("[]"),
                  \
    \    hasArgument(1, ignoringParenImpCasts(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    index"))))))
                    )
                  )
                )
\
    \              )
            ),
            hasThen(
              compoundStmt(
\
    \                statementCountIs(1),
                has(returnStmt(hasReturnValue(ignoringParenImpCasts(cxxBoolLiteral()))))
\
    \              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
\
    ).bind("loop")
"
- Diagnostic:
  - BindName: loop
    Level: Warning
    Message: Counting loop with a conditional increment; consider std::ranges::count_if
  Name: fastecu-count-if-loop
  Query: "match stmt(
  anyOf(
    cxxForRangeStmt(
      hasBody(
        compoundStmt(
\
    \          statementCountIs(1),
          has(
            ifStmt(
       \
    \       hasThen(
                compoundStmt(
                  statementCountIs(1),
\
    \                  has(unaryOperator(hasOperatorName("++")))
             \
    \   )
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
    ),
\
    \    forStmt(
      hasBody(
        compoundStmt(
          statementCountIs(1),
\
    \          has(
            ifStmt(
              hasThen(
               \
    \ compoundStmt(
                  statementCountIs(1),
                  has(unaryOperator(hasOperatorName("\
    ++")))
                )
              )
            )
          )
    \
    \    )
      )
    )
  )
).bind("loop")
"
- Diagnostic:
  - BindName: loop
    Level: Warning
    Message: Summing loop; consider std::ranges::fold_left (or std::accumulate) over
      the range
  Name: fastecu-accumulate-loop
  Query: "match stmt(
  anyOf(
    cxxForRangeStmt(
      hasLoopVariable(varDecl().bind("\
    element")),
      hasBody(
        compoundStmt(
          statementCountIs(1),
\
    \          has(
            anyOf(
              binaryOperator(
         \
    \       hasOperatorName("+="),
                hasLHS(declRefExpr()),
   \
    \             hasDescendant(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("element"\
    )))))
              ),
              cxxOperatorCallExpr(
                hasOverloadedOperatorName("\
    +="),
                hasArgument(0, declRefExpr()),
                hasDescendant(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    element")))))
              )
            )
          )
        )
     \
    \ )
    ),
    forStmt(
      hasLoopInit(declStmt(hasSingleDecl(varDecl().bind("\
    index")))),
      hasIncrement(
        unaryOperator(
          hasOperatorName("\
    ++"),
          hasUnaryOperand(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("index"\
    )))))
        )
      ),
      hasBody(
        compoundStmt(
          statementCountIs(1),
\
    \          has(
            anyOf(
              binaryOperator(
         \
    \       hasOperatorName("+="),
                hasLHS(declRefExpr()),
   \
    \             hasDescendant(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("index")))))
\
    \              ),
              cxxOperatorCallExpr(
                hasOverloadedOperatorName("\
    +="),
                hasArgument(0, declRefExpr()),
                hasDescendant(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    index")))))
              )
            )
          )
        )
      )
\
    \    )
  )
).bind("loop")
"
- Diagnostic:
  - BindName: loop
    Level: Warning
    Message: Loop appending one value per element; consider std::ranges::transform
      into std::back_inserter or std::views::transform with std::ranges::to
  Name: fastecu-transform-collect-loop
  Query: "match stmt(
  anyOf(
    cxxForRangeStmt(
      hasLoopVariable(varDecl().bind("\
    element")),
      hasBody(
        compoundStmt(
          statementCountIs(1),
\
    \          has(
            expr(
            anyOf(
              cxxMemberCallExpr(callee(cxxMethodDecl(hasAnyName("\
    push_back", "emplace_back"))), hasDescendant(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    element")))))),
              exprWithCleanups(has(cxxMemberCallExpr(callee(cxxMethodDecl(hasAnyName("\
    push_back", "emplace_back"))), hasDescendant(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    element"))))))))
            )
          )
          )
        )
      )
\
    \    ),
    forStmt(
      hasLoopInit(declStmt(hasSingleDecl(varDecl().bind("\
    index")))),
      hasIncrement(
        unaryOperator(
          hasOperatorName("\
    ++"),
          hasUnaryOperand(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("index"\
    )))))
        )
      ),
      hasBody(
        compoundStmt(
          statementCountIs(1),
\
    \          has(
            expr(
            anyOf(
              cxxMemberCallExpr(callee(cxxMethodDecl(hasAnyName("\
    push_back", "emplace_back"))), hasDescendant(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    index")))))),
              exprWithCleanups(has(cxxMemberCallExpr(callee(cxxMethodDecl(hasAnyName("\
    push_back", "emplace_back"))), hasDescendant(declRefExpr(to(varDecl(equalsBoundNode("\
    index"))))))))
            )
          )
          )
        )
      )
\
    \    )
  )
).bind("loop")
"
